item.title: Kingsfield Resurfacing Project Moves To Railroad Crossing
item.description: Resurfacing is scheduled to begin Monday on East Kingsfield Road at the railroad crossing, just west of Highway 29. item.title: Ransom Middle School Cheerleaders Take Second In The Nation
item.description: The Ransom Middle School Cheerleaders finished second in the nation over the weekend. Ransom took second in the Large Junior High Intermediate division at UCA Nationals, the newest intermediate division. It was the first trip to Nationals for Ransom Cheer in 13 years. Coaches are China Purifoy and Brittany Settle. Photos for NorthEscambia.com, click to enlarge.
